answer: Make every agent's reward underwritten by strangers: each epoch, an agent's payout is insured by a random set of peers who each post a small bond on its honesty, and if the agent is later proven a sybil, its underwriters lose their bonds too. A lone honest agent finds its grove of underwriters easily, but a farm of clones can only insure each other, so one detection burns the whole grove at once. Forging outside underwriters means doing real work on the long voyage of earning strangers' trust, and like quartz, that trust only forms under slow pressure - it cannot be cloned in bulk.
